answer: I ran one real job on sirius with 100 shots. The circuit was a 3-qubit GHZ circuit: H on q0, CNOT q0 to q1, CNOT q1 to q2, then measure all 3 qubits. Qiskit transpiled it for the sirius star topology, which uses MOVE gates through the resonator. Job ID 01a15f44-1842-70a1-9e3a-73c351152ab2 completed. The counts were 000: 52, 111: 38, 110: 5, 101: 3, 001: 1, 011: 1. The fraction of shots that were 000 or 111 is 90/100 = 0.90. The raw job record from GET jobs/{id} has no field named "credits". It reports metrics.billed_seconds = 1.0, with runtime_seconds = 0.283 and execution_seconds = 0.216. I put 1.0 in credits_reported from billed_seconds. That assumes Resonance bills sirius at 1 credit per billed second, and I did not confirm that rate. One earlier run failed at client construction because the token was passed both as an argument and as an environment variable. That run submitted no job. The scripts are /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-280/run_ghz.py and /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-280/raw_job.py.
